text: Biomedical engineering is an interdisciplinary field that combines engineering, biology, and medicine. Its core objective is to solve problems in the medical and health fields through engineering techniques, promoting medical innovation and improving the quality of health services. It serves as a "bridge" connecting engineering and life sciences, and is also the birthplace of modern medical equipment (such as CT, artificial hearts), diagnostic technologies (such as gene sequencing), and treatment plans (such as targeted drug delivery systems).
